summary: Verified AutoScroll ESLint fix (useCallback for start/stop) works at runtime. All requested behaviors pass: no compile overlay, buttons present, initial CirclePlay state, auto-scroll starts on first inert click (scrollY 0→90 in 1.5s), icon flips to CirclePause, toggle pauses (scrollY holds at 90) and resumes (90→181), manual wheel pauses autoscroll (icon returns to CirclePlay, scrollY holds at 483), audio remains paused throughout (no auto-start on gesture), zero console errors/warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AutoScroll.jsx cleanly uses useCallback with correct deps ([stop] for start, [] for stop). ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps resolved.
Minor: 'behavior: instant' in window.scrollBy is non-standard string; browsers accept it but 'auto' is the spec value. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AutoScroll + AudioToggle behavior validated end-to-end on preview URL. Deployment ESLint blocker is resolved.
